blocks.data: label:When the level starts: I do my own gravity and my own moving, so the Platformer leaves me alone
label:Read the arrow keys, x and space
label:Start each tick with the normal numbers: walking speed, a normal jump, normal gravity
label:Wall jump (part 1): just after pushing off a wall, I can't steer back into it
label:Wall slide (part 1): notice a wall beside me while I fall and push into it
label:Run with x: a higher top speed and a stronger push, and p speed once the run meter is full
label:Skid: pushing against the way I'm going slows me down hard on the ground, and turns me in the air
label:Walk: speed up toward my top speed, slow down when I let go, face the way I walk
label:Run meter: fills while I run flat out on the ground; full means p speed
label:Coyote time: I can still jump for a moment after running off a ledge
label:Jump buffer: pressing jump just before I land still counts
label:Faster jumps go higher: walking, running and p speed each jump a bit higher
label:Jump: space jumps when I'm on the ground
label:Wall jump (part 2): jumping while I slide down a wall pushes me off it
label:Forget an old jump press, one tick at a time
label:Hold to jump higher: gravity is lighter while I rise with space held
label:Gravity: pull me down every tick
label:Wall slide (part 2): sliding down a wall is slow, and grabbing one sheds speed fast
label:Top fall speed: never fall faster than this
label:Move: walls and floors stop me (go inside to see how)
label:Move and collide: move by my speeds; stop at anything solid, and tell it I bumped it
label:Wall slide (part 3): a wall on my right
label:Wall slide (part 3): a wall on my left
label:Run meter: running into a wall on my right drops it
label:Run meter: running into a wall on my left drops it
label:When a Spring says boing: fly up
label:When I stomp a Walker: bounce
label:When I get hurt: go back to the start
label:When a Bounce block says bounce: launch again, higher if I hold jump
